item.description:
Nexa 1.0.6

  • Much faster with many chats and long histories: catching up on messages that arrived while Nexa was closed takes seconds instead of up to a minute.
  • The window opens right away and shows a spinner while your chats load, instead of appearing only once everything is ready.
  • The chat list draws faster, and saving uses far less work per message, so Nexa stays responsive while messages come in.
